packageRules.description: Fork pin lattice: @module-federation/* is patched via pnpm patchedDependencies at an exact version (pnpm-workspace.yaml); any bump must move the patches in lockstep or install hard-fails. Keep out of the weekly grouped PR.

Fork pin lattice: TanStack Router versions are exact-pinned in plugin-runtime/plugin-tanstack and mirrored by packages/toolkit/ultramodern-create/src/ultramodern-workspace/versions.ts plus the release gates; bumps must update all of them in lockstep.
Redact is a patched framework-owned runtime; update its patch and Rsbuild integration together after SSR, hydration and real-React opt-out qualification.
Fork pin lattice: react-router/react-router-dom are pinned to an exact version via pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides; a package.json bump silently no-ops until the override moves with it.

Fork i18n surface: i18next is exact-pinned in packages/runtime/plugin-i18n devDependencies and react-i18next must satisfy the plugin's peer floor and MF/i18n integration fixtures; bump them together, outside the grouped weekly PR.
Fork BFF contract surface: farrow-api/pipeline/schema back the fork-owned @modern-js/bff-runtime adapters; keep bumps out of the grouped weekly PR so a farrow regression cannot poison it.
